messages.subject: Error in poppr
parts:
Hi

I recently updated my R and RStudio and started getting the following issue:

"Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘poppr’ in loadNamespace(j <- i[[1L]], c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[j]]):
 object 'vI' not found"

This happens when I try to load the "library(poppr)" (all required packages already installed)

I tried all pieces of advice from previous threads (https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/poppr/b9RqmE9fbEI), regarding similar problems, however, still no results. 

Any other cures?

Thanks in advance,

Dusan

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Error in poppr
parts:
Hi,

It's difficult to address this issue since I don't know what version of R or RStudio you are using or what platform you are running (it's also is not a poppr-specific issue). My generic advice for this is to search for any hidden files called ".RData" in your working folder and delete them. After you do that, restart R. In RStudio, go to Tools > Global Options > General and uncheck the box that says "Restore .RData into workspace on startup" and select "Never" under "Save workspace to .RData on exit"

Best,
Zhian
